reason: If it really gave me my evenings back I'd pay 99 € without blinking, but a LinkedIn ad saying 'AI co-workers' doesn't show me that. At most I'd poke at the free plan one night, and I'd probably never get around to setting it up properly.
objection: I don't have time to set it up and learn another tool, and I'm not sure 'connect your tools and build a knowledge base' is something I can do myself at 11pm after answering customer emails.
would_change_my_mind: If their onboarding team set it up for me in one call and I saw it answering my real customer emails and drafting my posts in my voice within the first week.
